_comment: Demo library — a tiny content pack that adds a Tiefling race and a Hellfire Aura effect. Role `library` means: editable in the editor, but hidden from the play picker; designed to be pulled in by playable modules via `uses`. Extends `default` so library authors get the same provenance-aware editor experience when adding records.
title: Tiefling Pack
description: Adds tiefling characters and infernal-flavored effects. Pull into any module with `uses: ["tiefling-pack"]`.
author: Matt
